entry.title: fix: probe the Live endpoint for key scope and explain blocked microp…
entry.content:
fix: probe the Live endpoint for key scope and explain blocked microphones

- Preflight now POSTs an empty body to /v1/live/sessions: auth and scopes
  are checked before validation, so a restricted key missing the Live
  scope is caught (401 missing_scope) while a good key gets a harmless 400.
- 401 missing-scope refusals point to the restricted-key permission fix.
- macOS: a previously denied microphone is reported with a dialog naming
  System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone (app appears as Electron).
- Client: getUserMedia DOMExceptions become actionable messages.

Co-authored-by: Jamal <jamal.hinton@gmail.com>

entry.title: fix: diagnose rejected OpenAI keys and keep Live open on non-fatal er…
entry.content:
fix: diagnose rejected OpenAI keys and keep Live open on non-fatal errors

- Preflight OPENAI_API_KEY with GET /v1/models at startup; /api/state now
  reports liveReason and stops advertising Live after a 401/403.
- Explain 401/403/429 refusals with OpenAI's message and the restart step
  instead of a generic 'refused (502)'.
- Trim pasted keys; log the key check result and the key's last 4 chars.
- Desktop launcher warns when it reuses a running server whose stale key
  ignores the new LIVE_ENABLED/OPENAI_API_KEY environment.
- Client: Live 'error' events after session.started are notices (rejected
  commands, moderation cut-offs), not session teardown; startup errors
  still end the session. UI shows the server's reason when Live is off.
- Regression tests for preflight, session 401, launcher notice and the
  error-event handling.

Co-authored-by: Jamal <jamal.hinton@gmail.com>

entry.title: fix: keep Live up after permission and play Miette’s voice
entry.content:
fix: keep Live up after permission and play Miette’s voice

Granting the microphone still tore the session down: AudioContext
autoplay failures were treated as fatal, a data-channel close during
connect ended the peer, Electron denied getUserMedia unless mediaTypes
was exactly audio, and the audio element never opted into autoplay or
STUN. Demo and avatar clicks also had no local speech.

Startup now unlocks playback, uses STUN, asks to receive audio, ignores
pre-negotiation channel close and AudioContext errors, and accepts
audio/microphone permission requests. Demo speaks Miette’s lines locally
and a click on her replays the last one.

Co-authored-by: Jamal <jamal.hinton@gmail.com>

entry.title: Add a microphone button that starts live, cuts in on Miette, and pauses
entry.content:
Add a microphone button that starts live, cuts in on Miette, and pauses

The button below Start demo shares the stage state machine: idle starts
the same consent-gated live flow, listening pauses, paused resumes, and
while Miette is speaking it interrupts her. Interrupt now silences local
playback, sends a tutor-framed stop hint, and restores sound automatically
once the learner has spoken and a new reply arrives, without ending the
session. The Interrupt/Resume audio tool button follows the same state.

Co-authored-by: Jamal <jamal.hinton@gmail.com>

entry.title: Start live from the avatar pill and add a pause/play control while live
entry.content:
Start live from the avatar pill and add a pause/play control while live

Clicking the avatar or the status pill when idle opens the existing parent
consent flow (LIVE_ENABLED / API key gates and 10-minute limit unchanged).
When live is unavailable, an inline reason appears under the pill instead
of a silent no-op. Once a session exists the pill becomes a pause/play
button: pause disables the mic track and silences playback while keeping
the session open, so play resumes instantly. Remaining session time is
shown in the pill. Stage view logic lives in src/stage.ts and is covered
by node tests; LiveSession pause/mute/interrupt switches are reconciled
in one place.

Co-authored-by: Jamal <jamal.hinton@gmail.com>
